newsitem.title: USA: TBS Inc names Wayne Pace CFO.
newsitem.headline: TBS Inc names Wayne Pace CFO.

text.p: TBS Inc said Monday that Wayne Pace has been named executive vice president and chief financial and administrative officer.
TBS Inc is the Time Warner subsidiary consisting of the former holdings of Turner Broadcasting. The appointment is effective immediately, a statement from TBS said.

In this newly created position, Pace will continue to be responsible for all financial activities and will take on additional responsibilities for all administrative activities and general corporate matters.

Pace joined TBS in July 1993 as vice president, finance and chief financial officer after serving as an audit partner in the Atlanta office of Price Waterhouse where he had worked on the Turner account since 1970.
